title: Warren Buffett's first stock taught him this
caption:
At 11, Warren Buffett bought 3 shares of Cities Service at about $38.
They fell to $27. When they got back to $40, he sold.
Soon after, they climbed to about $200. His lesson: patience.
comment: What's the best investing lesson you learned the hard way? 👇
sources: Alice Schroeder, The Snowball: Warren Buffett and the Business of Life (2008)

scenes.say: Warren Buffett bought his first stock when he was eleven.
He paid about thirty-eight dollars a share.
It fell to twenty-seven. When it got back to forty, he sold.
scenes.sub: he sold for a tiny profit

scenes.say: Soon after, it shot up to about two hundred dollars.
